item.title: OpenStack GPU Cloud for Precision Agriculture
item.description:
Institution

GreenAI (Precision Agriculture), HPC Department, NASTP, Rawalpindi
Feb 2026 - Present

Project Description

GreenAI’s precision agriculture teams and its IaaS clients needed a place to run their workloads, including GPU-heavy ones. I built that platform and now look after it.

Project Highlights

  • Deployed OpenStack across more than 20 bare metal nodes using MAAS, Sunbeam, Juju, MicroCeph and OVN.
  • Set up Kubernetes with GPU passthrough and provisioned GPU virtual machines for internal teams and clients.
  • Moved vendor-provided and in-house applications from testing into a secure production environment, with CI/CD pipelines, rollback procedures and automated nightly backups.
  • Lead the HPC administration team, review configuration changes and plan the 24/7 shift roster.

Technical Skills Acquired

  • OpenStack
  • Kubernetes
  • Ceph and OVN
  • CI/CD
